recentItems.description:
The Flame of the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games has been ignited, and we've embarked on the journey to the first-ever Olympic sporting event in Africa! 🔥

Following the traditional ceremony, the Youth Olympic Flame will now travel to and across Senegal, bringing the spirit of the Youth Olympic Games to communities across the country.

recentItems.title: Olympic Flame Lighting Ceremony | Dakar 2026
recentItems.description:
📺 Watch more #Dakar2026 action➡️: https://oly.ch/4hk47Vr

The arrival of the Youth Olympic flame in September will mark one of the defining moments on the road to Dakar 2026. 

Following the lighting ceremony in Athens on 10 September, the flame will arrive in Dakar on 12 September before beginning a 30-stop journey across all regions of Senegal.  Supported by further local celebrations across the African continent, the tour is designed to bring the Games experience into communities and build anticipation ahead of the Opening Ceremony.

The Dakar 2026 YOG will take place from 31 October to 13 November 2026, bringing together around 2,700 young athletes aged up to 17 across three host zones: Dakar, Diamniadio and Saly.

recentItems.title: FULL Gold Medal Match | Men's Table Tennis 🇸🇪🏓🇨🇳 | Paris 2024
recentItems.description:
📺 Re-live #Paris2024! ➡️ https://oly.ch/3REmN8s

The People's Republic of China's Fan Zhendong beat Sweden’s Truls Möregårdh 4-1 to win his first individual Olympic gold medal at Paris 2024. As the 2024 singles world champion, this was the second time that year that Fan stood atop the podium after days of gruelling competition against the greatest table tennis players in the world.
